R88 a notice signed by a release key in the list, newer than the running release, is stored and the check records found; the request is a plain GET of the fixed address that sends no cookie, credential, slug, member or setting: its address is the constant, its headers are accept and a fixed user agent, no body, no redirect followed

R88 controls: one character of the notes changed stores nothing and records BAD_SIGNATURE; an older correctly signed notice records NOT_NEWER; the release that runs records none; a notice signed in another namespace records NAMESPACE; by a key not in the list UNKNOWN_KEY; every outcome stores nothing and a later good notice is still found
R88 a notice no newer than one already held is not stored again, so a replayed older notice changes nothing: the same release records none, an older one NOT_NEWER, a newer one found

R88 a notice that is no well-formed signed JSON object records MALFORMED and stores nothing: not JSON, an array, no signature, a field missing, a signature of nothing; a notice over 64 KiB is refused with no more than 64 KiB and a little read

R88 a failed fetch records unreachable, stores no notice and raises nothing: a fetch that throws, a 404, a 500, a redirect (never followed), the governor holding the host (nothing is asked); the next day's run tries again and finds the notice
R88 the notes are held as plain text exactly as signed and never interpreted: markup, a link and a script in them come back as the same characters
R88 at each start, when VERSION differs from the last running version recorded, the release now running is recorded with the instant first seen; a start of the same version records nothing more

R89 updateNotice is an administrators' read: a member and a machine (class:admin, class:ai) and no one are refused NOT_AN_ADMIN (membership R84) and read nothing; control: an administrator is answered

R89 before any notice the answer carries the running release, no last check and nothing ready; after a check it carries the last check, and a ready release with its signed notes, its date, its security mark, when it was found and its latest decision (null before any)

R89 holder names who holds the group's hosting account as membership records it, and viewer_holds says whether the viewer is named in it: the viewer 'second' holds it, 'admin' does not; with none recorded holder is null and viewer_holds false; a membership that cannot answer leaves both unread (null), never a guess

R89 earlier lists each release offered before, newest first, at most 50 with the cut said: a release installed carries installed_at and allowed_by, a release skipped skipped_at, skipped_by and reason; control: fewer than the bound is not truncated

R89 updateNoticeState is the in-process read for the administrators' to-do: {running, ready, decisions} for the newest release ready, naming no viewer; ready null and no decisions when none; a skipped release is no longer ready
R89 a store that does not answer is the store's silence (R43): updateNotice and updateNoticeState answer STORE_DID_NOT_ANSWER, never a throw and never ready: null as if nothing were there
R89 the reads write nothing

R90 updateStart records the choice and answers the installer's update page set to that release and no other, carrying no credential, slug or member; nothing is installed and nothing is fetched by it; updateNotice then shows the decision with who and when

R90 updateStart refusals: a member and a machine NOT_AN_ADMIN first, before the version is looked at; an older, a newer, an unknown, an empty version and no release held UPDATE_NOT_READY; each writes nothing; control: the ready version is accepted
R90 updateLater sets the release aside for 14 days; control: a later choice takes it back; a newer release replaces it at once (it is ready with no decision)

R90 updateLater on a security release sets it aside until the start of the next local day in the profile's zone: 20:00 UTC is 13:00 on the 14th in Los Angeles, so until 2026-10-15T07:00:00Z; with no profile's zone, until the next UTC midnight; control: the same release not marked security waits 14 days

R90 updateSkip records the administrator's reason with who and when and the release is never ready again; the next release is offered as usual; control: updateskip without a reason (none, blank, over 1,000 characters, two lines) is refused UPDATE_SKIP_NO_REASON, nothing written
R90 R29 over the routes: updatenotice, updatestart, updatelater and updateskip read the control plane's stamps (viewer, by) from the query and never from the body
